description: This file defines a React component 'Payments' that provides a UI for managing payments, including listing, creating, editing, and deleting payment entries. It uses React hooks for state management and side effects, and interacts with an API service for data operations.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches the list of payments from the API and updates state.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission to create or update a payment.

methods.name: onEdit
methods.description: Prepares the form for editing an existing payment item.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes a payment entry after user confirmation.
